properties.name: Point Reyes: Coast Trail to Alamere Falls & Wildcat
properties.trailhead_campground: Point Reyes: Wildcat Camp / Coast Camp
properties.description: Legendary coastal bluff trail leading past coastal ocean lakes to the rare 40-foot tidefall waterfall Alamere Falls and Wildcat Beach.

properties.name: Tomales Point Trail (Tule Elk Reserve)
properties.description: Winds along the narrow coastal ridge between Tomales Bay and the roaring Pacific Ocean through the protected Tule Elk sanctuary to Tomales Point.

properties.name: Yosemite: Mist Trail & Half Dome Cables
properties.description: Ascends granite steps misted by Vernal and Nevada Falls, through Little Yosemite Valley, ascending the famous 400-foot cable route to the summit of Half Dome (8,842 ft).

properties.name: Yosemite: Upper Yosemite Fall & Yosemite Point
properties.description: Switchbacks up granite cliffs alongside North America's tallest waterfall (2,425 ft) to the roaring brink and panoramic Yosemite Point.

properties.name: John Muir Trail (JMT) - High Sierra Section
properties.park_name: Yosemite, Ansel Adams & John Muir Wilderness
properties.description: The world's premier mountain footpath traversing the Sierra Crest from Happy Isles through Cathedral Pass, Donohue Pass, Evolution Valley to Mount Whitney.

properties.name: Pacific Crest Trail (PCT) - Sierra Crest Passage
properties.description: Ridgetop pathway following the glaciated backbone of the Sierra Nevada, traversing Carson Pass, Lake Aloha, and high granite passes.

properties.name: Mount Tallac Trail (Desolation Wilderness)
properties.trailhead_campground: Fallen Leaf / Camp Richardson / Emerald Bay
properties.description: Glacial moraines past Cathedral and Floating Island Lakes to the 9,735-foot summit of Mount Tallac, providing the finest panorama of Lake Tahoe.

properties.name: Tahoe Rim Trail: Relay Peak to Mount Rose
properties.park_name: Lake Tahoe Basin / Mount Rose Wilderness
properties.description: High-altitude traverse along North Lake Tahoe's highest volcanic rim with sweeping vistas across Lake Tahoe and the Great Basin.

properties.name: Mount Whitney Trail (Highest Peak in Contiguous US)
properties.park_name: Inyo National Forest / John Muir Wilderness
properties.description: Ascends from pine forests at Whitney Portal (8,360 ft), past Lone Pine Lake and Trail Camp, through the famed 99 Switchbacks to the 14,505-foot summit.

properties.name: North Fork Big Pine Creek Trail (Temple Crag & 7 Lakes)
properties.park_name: John Muir Wilderness / Inyo National Forest
properties.description: Follows roaring glacier-fed Big Pine Creek to turquoise glacial lakes sitting beneath the 13,000-foot sheer granite wall of Temple Crag and Palisade Glacier.

properties.name: Alabama Hills: Mobius Arch Loop Trail
properties.description: Walk among rounded golden monzogranite boulder mazes to natural rock arches perfectly framing snow-capped Mount Whitney.

properties.name: Mount Diablo: Grand Loop & Summit Trail
properties.description: Encircles Mount Diablo via Juniper and Deer Flat trails to the 3,849-foot summit with panoramic views across 40 counties and the Golden Gate.

properties.name: Castle Dome & Root Creek Trail
properties.description: Steep rocky climb through ponderosa pines into the heart of 6,000-foot granite spires with towering views of snow-clad Mount Shasta.

properties.name: Lassen Peak Trail (Active Volcano Summit)
properties.description: Climbs the rocky volcanic scree and switchbacks to the 10,457-foot summit of Lassen Peak, one of the world's largest plug dome volcanoes.

properties.name: Bumpass Hell Hydrothermal Boardwalk
properties.description: Boardwalk trail above bubbling mudpots, boiling turquoise hydrothermal springs, roaring fumaroles, and sulfur steaming vents.
